message.content:
**Short answer:** Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta, but it’s handled by the city’s *Police Department* or *Code Enforcement* rather than the City Council itself. The City Council can help you get the right department involved, but the actual enforcement is done by the police or the Department of Public Safety. --- ## How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Call | |------|------------|---------------------------| | **1. Gather details** | • Date & time of the noise
• Location (address or intersection)
• Description of the sound (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs)
• Any evidence (audio/video, photos) | — | | **2. Contact the Atlanta Police Department (APD)** | • **Phone:** 404‑656‑3111 (or 911 if it’s an emergency)
• **Online form:** [Noise Complaint Form](https://www.atlantapd.org/Noise-Complaint) | APD | | **3. Use the 311 Service** | • **Phone:** 404‑656‑3111 (same line as APD)
• **Online:** [311 Atlanta](https://www.atlantaga.gov/311) | 311 (City of Atlanta) | | **4. Email (optional)** | • noise@atlantaga.gov | City of Atlanta | | **5. If the issue is ongoing or you want a formal investigation** | • File a written complaint with the **Department of Public Safety – Code Enforcement**. | 404‑656‑3111 or visit the City Hall (55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303) | ### Why the City Council Isn’t the First Stop - The City Council’s role is to set policy and pass ordinances. - Enforcement of noise ordinances is delegated to the **Atlanta Police Department** and the **Department of Public Safety**. - If you feel your complaint isn’t being addressed, you can bring it to the attention of your **City Council Representative** (each council member has a dedicated office and email). --- ## Useful Links & Resources | Resource | Link | |----------|------| | City of Atlanta Official Site | https://www.atlantaga.gov | | Noise Ordinance (Georgia & Atlanta) | https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/department-of-public-safety/traffic-and-transportation/noise-ordinance | | Atlanta Police Department – Noise Complaint | https://www.atlantapd.org/Noise-Complaint | | 311 Atlanta (non-emergency services) | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 | | City Council Contact Page | https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/city-council | | City Hall Address | 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303 | --- ## Quick FAQ | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | **Do I need to be a resident to file a complaint?** | No, anyone can file a noise complaint in Atlanta. | | **What if the noise is from a neighbor’s party?** | Report it to APD; they’ll investigate and enforce the noise ordinance. | | **Can I file a complaint anonymously?** | Yes, but providing contact info helps the police follow up. | | **What if the noise continues after a complaint?** | Follow up with APD or the City Council; persistent violations may lead to fines or other enforcement actions. | --- ### Bottom line - **File the complaint with the Atlanta Police Department or 311.** - **If you’re not satisfied with the response, contact your City Council representative** for assistance. Feel free to let me know if you need help filling out the online form or locating your local council member’s office!
